conventions.convention: Total variation is the supremum of absolute event-probability differences.
The general LAN expansion uses linear coefficient Delta_n and Gaussian center V^{-1}Delta_n. The misspecified iid theorem instead names S_n as its linear coefficient and defines Delta_n=V^{-1}S_n.
Posterior contraction is required outside delta_n M_n for every deterministic sequence M_n tending to infinity; consistency alone is insufficient.

QMD supplies fixed-convergent-sequence LAN through normalized absolutely continuous likelihood proxies. Compact-uniform proxy LAN is a separate premise, and a full Radon–Nikodym derivative for the local alternative is not asserted.
The log-Lipschitz bound holds simultaneously for all local parameter pairs on one measurable full set. Suprema use measurable versions obtained by zero extension off that set.
V is positive-definite KL curvature, whereas I=E_0[ss^T] may be singular and need not equal V. Posterior covariance is V^{-1}; estimator sampling covariance is V^{-1}IV^{-1}.

BvM assumes an interior center in an open parameter space, supplied jointly measurable finite-valued densities, a proper prior density continuous and positive near the center, and finite positive evidence almost surely.

load_bearing.statement: Under its supplied dominated-density setup, AC, an interior center, proper continuous positive prior density, finite positive evidence, compact-uniform LAN with positive-definite V and bounded-in-probability Delta_n, and contraction outside delta_n M_n for every deterministic M_n tending to infinity, the posterior law of delta_n^{-1}(theta-theta*) is o_P(1) in total variation from N_d(V^{-1}Delta_n,V^{-1}).

For an iid sample and a locally indexed class with f_0=0 and a common pointwise Lipschitz envelope M satisfying PM^2<infinity, the expected centered empirical-process supremum on a radius-r ball is at most C_d r(PM^2)^{1/2}; its modulus over pairs at distance at most epsilon is at most C_d epsilon sqrt(log(e r/epsilon))(PM^2)^{1/2}, for 0<epsilon<=r. Both suprema have measurable versions.

Under the supplied dominated iid density setup, a finite interior KL minimizer, the stated positive-definite quadratic contrast expansion, differentiability in P_0-probability, and a common square-integrable local log-Lipschitz envelope, E_0s=0, I=E_0[ss^T] is finite, and the iid log-likelihood ratio has compact-uniform root-n LAN expansion h^TS_n-h^TVh/2. In particular V^{-1}S_n=O_P(1).

Under the misspecified iid LAN hypotheses and AC, a measurable consistent estimator satisfying the stated measurable finite-supremum o_P(n^{-1}) approximate-maximization condition obeys sqrt(n)(theta_hat_n-theta*)=V^{-1}S_n+o_P(1), converging in distribution to N_d(0,V^{-1}IV^{-1}). The optional posterior recentering additionally assumes the stated prior, evidence, and every-diverging-radius root-n contraction conditions.
